methods.description: Identify numerical and any common algebraic HCF, choose its negative outside, divide every term by that signed factor once, and verify by expansion. HCF1, mixed signs, powers and three terms are variations of this rule.

sourceReview.locator: Complete governing factor clause/whole HCF teaching examples guided KeyIdeas or filled negative-factor task
sourceReview.observation: Complete actual governing clauses and whole numerical/algebraic HCF teaching, examples, guided parts, KeyIdeas, negative-power filled table and full three-term filled task personally read. Source divides once by outside factor and checks by expansion. Explicit negative outputs −2(3−5p²) and −4y(3x+2z+5xz) bound. Source also permits positive6(−1+2p²), so negative choice is a useful form, not mathematical necessity.
sourceReview.adjustments: Clarify choice of negative factor and remove ambiguous divide-then-flip wording: divide by the signed outside factor once. Preserve every original assessment/option/why/ID/order and all numeric/variable values. New2examples5parts adapt the same HCF/division/check method; numerical versus algebraic factors are variants, not inflated separate methods. No learner diagrams or later factorisation algorithms.
